## C2 PICO 筛选分析

对 10 条记录逐条应用 C2 标准（原始研究 RCT/队列；干预/暴露=二甲双胍；人群=2型糖尿病成人；结局含 HbA1c）：

| ID | 设计 | 干预/暴露 | 人群 | 结局 | 判定 |
|:---|:-----|:----------|:-----|:-----|:-----|
| S1 | RCT | metformin vs placebo | T2DM adults | HbA1c | ✅ |
| S2 | RCT | diet+exercise | T2DM adults | fasting glucose | ❌ 无 metformin，无 HbA1c |
| S3 | cohort | metformin | T2DM adults | HbA1c | ✅ |
| S4 | RCT | SGLT2 inhibitor | T2DM adults | HbA1c | ❌ 非 metformin |
| S5 | RCT | metformin ER | T2DM adults | HbA1c | ✅ |
| S6 | systematic review | metformin | — | HbA1c | ❌ 排除（综述/meta） |
| S7 | RCT | smartphone coaching | T2DM adults | HbA1c | ❌ 非 metformin |
| S8 | case report | insulin | — | — | ❌ 排除（个案报告） |
| S9 | RCT | metformin + GLP-1 RA | T2DM adults | HbA1c | ✅ |
| S10 | RCT | metformin dose comparison | T2DM adults | HbA1c | ✅ |

答案: S1, S3, S5, S9, S10
